description: Get a compound's bioactivity profile: which assays tested it, activity outcomes (Active/Inactive/Inconclusive), target identifiers (NCBI Gene ID, UniProt/GenBank accession), and quantitative values (IC50, EC50, Ki, etc.). Filter by outcome and/or a specific molecular target (NCBI Gene ID or protein accession) to focus the profile — e.g. "is this compound active against target T?".

cid.description: PubChem Compound ID. Resolve from name/SMILES with pubchem_search_compounds.

maxResults.description: Max assay results to return per page. The per-call cap is 100: a larger value (up to 1000) returns a page of 100 and is reported in cappedInputs. Well-studied compounds have thousands of records; use offset to reach the ones past this page. Default: 20.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first assay to return, applied after the outcome and target filters. Pass the nextOffset from a previous call to read the following page. Default: 0.

outcomeFilter.description: Filter by activity outcome against each assay's reported target: the target a target filter matched, else the first target the assay lists. For a multi-target assay, outcomes against its other targets (in otherTargets) do not count. "active" keeps assays where that outcome is Active — most useful for understanding biological profile. Default: "all".

targetAccession.description: Filter to assays against this target protein accession (UniProt/RefSeq/GenBank/PDB chain), e.g. "P35354", including assays recorded only under a Gene ID or another accession this compound's assay table pairs with it. Uppercased before matching; a PDB chain ID (the "A" in "1ZHH_A") is kept as given. With targetGeneId, both must name the same target — when the table ties them to different targets, nothing matches. Obtain accessions from pubchem_search_assays or the targetAccession field of an unfiltered result here.

targetGeneId.description: Filter to assays against this NCBI Gene ID (1 to 2147483647), including assays recorded only under a protein accession this compound's assay table pairs with the Gene ID (e.g. 5742 also reaches rows carrying only P23219 when another row pairs the two). Obtain Gene IDs from pubchem_search_assays or the targetGeneId field of an unfiltered result here. Combine with outcomeFilter="active" to answer "is this compound active against target T?".

name: pubchem_get_bioactivity

activeCount.description: Assays whose outcome against their first listed target is "Active", across all assays and before any filter. A multi-target assay counts by its first target only.

cap.description: The page size applied: maxResults, or the per-call cap when maxResults exceeds it.

cappedInputs.description: Inputs that asked for more than their per-call cap, with the value requested and the value served. An ID batch lists the IDs past the cap in unprocessed. Omitted when every input was within its cap.

items.description: One input served at its per-call cap.

requested.description: Value requested: the page size, or the number of IDs in the batch.

unprocessed.description: ID batches only: IDs past the cap, listed in unprocessed in input order.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filteredCount.description: Exact number of assays matching the outcome and target filters, across all pages.

inactiveCount.description: Assays whose outcome against their first listed target is "Inactive", across all assays and before any filter. A multi-target assay counts by its first target only.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call to continue past this page. Omitted when no further assays match.

notice.description: Recovery guidance when the filter yields no results or the compound has no bioactivity data.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first assay returned.

outcomeFilter.description: Outcome filter applied: active, inactive, or all.

activityValues.description: Quantitative activity measurements against the reported target.

name.description: Measurement name (e.g. IC50, EC50, Ki). Omitted when not reported.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. uM, nM). Omitted when not reported.

otherTargets.description: The assay's other targets, each with its own outcome and measurements. Present only for an assay whose rows name more than one target.

items.description: Another target of the assay, with its own outcome and values.

accession.description: Protein accession. Omitted when the row names none.

activityValues.description: Quantitative activity measurements against this target.

name.description: Measurement name (e.g. IC50, EC50, Ki). Omitted when not reported.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. uM, nM). Omitted when not reported.

geneId.description: NCBI Gene ID. Omitted when the row names none.

outcome.description: Activity outcome against the reported target — the one a target filter matched, else the assay's first: Active, Inactive, Inconclusive, Unspecified.

targetFilter.description: Target identifiers matched, when a target filter is set: those passed plus every Gene ID and accession the compound's assay table pairs with them. When the two inputs name different targets, only the two inputs.

totalAssays.description: Total unique assays for this compound.

truncated.description: True when matching assays remain past this page.

title: Get Bioactivity
